title: Frozen-parent reproduction, runtime audit and actual-date spin-up

environment_audit.openmp_amendment: Use the Conda Intel OpenMP runtime; the duplicate Torch libiomp5md.dll remains archived as libiomp5md.dll.codex_backup_20260902

reproduction.comparison: The DYN2P/Q72 process layer must reproduce Stage 9 within numpy allclose rtol=1e-8 and atol=1e-8. Separately, the unchanged R2 implementation is replayed with the legacy 2006 activation registry and must reproduce Stage 24. Historical activation is applied only after both parity tests pass.
reproduction.failure_behavior: Stop before the historical run and diagnose implementation/runtime drift; never accept a merely similar NSE

spinup.land_states: periodic convergence of all frozen DYN2P states
spinup.reservoir_states: Later reservoirs remain zero until their registered activation date. Xinfengjiang, commissioned 1960-10-01, is initialized from an empty state with one registered 92-day October-December donor climatology from the spun-up 1961 cycle; it is not assigned an artificial multi-year equilibrium storage.
spinup.diagnostic_sensitivity: Zero-state and a longer repeated-window initialization may be reported only as decay/convergence diagnostics and cannot replace the registered primary initialization after seeing discharge

forbidden: changing the checkpoint or R2 parameters
using fixed 2006 dates inside the historical periodic spin-up
